text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: There are many "triple crowns" in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Among them is the Classic Triple Crown, a tour open to runners only once in their lifetime. Why do so many decide to take on the challenge?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well, firstly, popular opinion states that the Triple Crown champion is the face of her generation.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The Classic Triple Crown is a fleeting opportunity to show one's prowess. Effort is not the only factor here—luck is important as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Speed, luck, and strength. It is a perilous path, but that peril is itself the answer you seek.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It's the reason why both runners and fans alike cannot resist the glimmer of that crown.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thus, the Triple Crown champion assumes a position unparalleled, becoming a pillar of hope and trust.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: So you could say that challengers are vying for that position.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well, that's considering just one element of the complexity that comprises the Triple Crown tour.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And take it only as my opinion. Were you to ask another Umamusume, and in particular—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Aren't you overthinking things?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Here's a question for you, Miss Reporter. Why do you think that bird is flying in the sky?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Hm? Well, it's circling around so… maybe it's hunting for food?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hehe, there you go overthinking things again. The answer is much simpler than that.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: It flies because birds can fly. No?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I run because I am an Umamusume. I follow where my heart leads me, to where the breeze blows.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: And if I find a path that looks fun, I enjoy all it has to offer. No matter what awaits me there.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Although, I know someone who sees it the other way around.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …The strongest competitors take on the Triple Crown tour. What other choice is there but to challenge them?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: So you're not worried about the caliber of these strong competitors?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: No. That's the point. Plus, everyone knows they only get one shot, so they put everything on the line.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Only after clashing with the best can you be called the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Oh! That brings me back to a point Symboli Rudolf made about the "position" of the Triple Crown champion. So, you would agree that earning the title places you at a point unparall—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: No. It's only the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Becoming the strongest only earns you entry into the hunting grounds where those with even more strength gather.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: And if you want to challenge them, you've got to prove that you're a real threat. Otherwise, what's the point?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Once you stand alongside those who've earned the same title… that's when fangs are bared for real.

text_block_list.name: Twinkle Monthly
text_block_list.text: "Though it may mean different things to different runners, the Triple Crown has an unquestionable and irresistible allure."

text_block_list.name: Twinkle Monthly
text_block_list.text: "That is why Umamusume choose this path, from the champions of the past to the winners of the future. —Etsuko Otonashi"
